The accused had beaten the deceased girl and broke her right hand and had also kicked her in the face, drawing blood.
The deceased girl was treated cruelly by the accused during her lifetime before the incident.

The prosecution was further successful in proving that the accused was repeatedly getting in and out of the room of the house on the night of the criminal incident and the accused had fed the deceased girl Khichdi at night.
The prosecution has also been successful in proving that the deceased girl's pajama was worn upside down.

Anita had taken off the pajama of the deceased girl and thrown it in front of a closed room.

It was said that if the medical report and the post-mortem report corroborate the prosecution's version as to the time and manner of the incident, minor discrepancies in a crime like murder and rape cannot be considered to be unbelievable.
